{/* Section 1: Hero Banner */}
Bespoke Window Elegance

Jillu Curtains & Insect Nets

Crafting luxury custom drapes, thermal blackout curtains, and precision-engineered mosquito mesh systems tailored for your space.

{/* Section 2: Core Highlights */}

Custom Drapery

Hand-tailored sheer voiles, velvet drapes, and motorization integrations.

Mosquito Screens

Pleated accordion doors, magnetic frames, and SS304 anti-pet wire mesh.

100% Blackout

3-pass thermal linings that eliminate light and dampen noise pollution.

{/* Section 3: Premium Fabrics Preview */}

Engineered For Perfection

From stain-resistant jacquard fabrics to heavy-duty stainless steel screen mesh, every material utilized by Jillu Curtains is built for durability, elegance, and low maintenance.

{/* Section 4: Quick Workflow */}

How We Work

02

Fabric & Style Selection

03

Custom Tailoring

{/* Section 5: Client Guarantee */}

Free Measurement

Zero consultation fees within city limits.

Custom Fit Assurance

100% precision fit for all window types.

Durable Warranty

Comprehensive coverage on mesh mechanisms.

{/* Section 6: Home CTA */}

Transform Your Home Interior

Get in touch today for an instant estimate or home measurement session.

Master Craftsmen

About Jillu Curtains

Decades of expertise in custom window fashion and protective screening.

{/* Section 2: Our Story */}

Our Journey

Jillu Curtains started with a single mission: to deliver bespoke drapery and high-grade insect protection without compromising on aesthetic luxury. Over the years, we have served thousands of homes, villas, and commercial offices with tailored solutions.

{/* Section 3: In-House Fabrication */}

Zero Subcontracting

{/* Section 6: About CTA */}

Work With Custom Drapery Experts

Let us guide you through fabric selection, light control, and window protection.

); /* ========================================================================== PAGE 3: SERVICES PAGE (6 SECTIONS) ========================================================================== */ const ServicesPage = ({ setActiveTab }) => (
{/* Section 1: Hero Header */}

Our Services & Solutions

Detailed breakdown of bespoke tailoring services, mosquito mesh installation, and track engineering.

{/* Section 2: Service 1 */}

1. Bespoke Curtain Tailoring Service

Hand-stitched drapes designed precisely around your room's ceiling height, floor clearance, and window width. We craft pinch pleat, box pleat, ripplefold, and grommet eyelet styles.

{/* Section 3: Service 2 */}

2. Mosquito Screen Door & Window Systems

Engineered protection against mosquitoes, flies, and pests without blocking outdoor sunlight or fresh air flow.

{/* Section 4: Service 3 */}

3. Thermal & Blackout Drapes

Block 100% of unwanted UV rays and external heat with multi-layer insulating drapes, improving energy efficiency.

{/* Section 5: Motorization & Track Systems */}

Automated Motorized Tracks

Upgrade your window management with quiet motorized track systems operated via remote control, smartphone app, or home automation integration.

{/* Section 6: Services CTA */}

Need a Service Consultation?

Get in touch with our technicians for an accurate on-site quote.
